tasks.title: Gather Ingredients & Equipment
tasks.description: Collect the Maggi noodles packet, appropriate amount of water, a cooking pot, and ensure a heat source is available.

tasks.title: Boil Water & Add Noodles
tasks.description: Pour the required water into the pot, bring it to a rolling boil, then carefully add the Maggi noodles.

tasks.title: Add Seasoning & Simmer
tasks.description: Stir in the seasoning packet from the Maggi packet and continue to cook until the noodles are tender and most of the water has been absorbed.

tasks.title: Serve & Enjoy
tasks.description: Carefully transfer the hot Maggi noodles into a serving bowl and enjoy your freshly prepared meal.

tasks.title: Gather Coffee Essentials
tasks.description: Collect coffee beans or grounds, fresh water, a coffee maker, a filter, and a mug.

tasks.title: Set Up Coffee Machine
tasks.description: Fill the coffee maker's reservoir with water and add the appropriate amount of coffee grounds to the filter.

tasks.title: Initiate Brewing Process
tasks.description: Turn on the coffee maker and allow it to complete the brewing cycle.

tasks.title: Serve and Customize Coffee
tasks.description: Pour the freshly brewed coffee into a mug and add milk, sugar, or other desired condiments.
